Cover arithmetic closes independently: 1,300.00 last + 150.00 this = 1,450.00. 3-line 2024 form, single contrib_all cell, no <=$50 aggregate line, so the line-1/line-2 basis rule does not apply. No in-kind line on the sheet, so both in-kind conventions give the same sum.
